snippet.title: WANGZHA: Dou Dizhu Roguelike – Official Trailer | Free Demo Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
The free demo of WANGZHA: Dou Dizhu Roguelike is out now on Steam.
▶ Play the demo / wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5271980/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_v6

WANGZHA is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Dou Dizhu ("Fight the Landlord"), the Chinese shedding game (think President or Big Two) where a 2 beats an Ace. Play straights, planes and bombs against landlords who keep raising the rent. The rules stay exactly as they are. Multipliers aren't drawn here, they're grown: every seal you own gets stronger with each hand you play.

IN THE DEMO
• 5 landlords, from the village to the Prefecture. Beat the fifth and the demo is won
• 35 growing seals, 13 of them unlocked by playing the demo
• 3 decks, and all 12 hand types exactly as in Dou Dizhu
• 3 harvest years: clear one to open the next
• A guided first run: a hand on the table within 30 seconds
• No run limit, about 25 minutes a run
• Steam Cloud saves shared with the full game: runs, seals and unlocks carry over

The full game arrives in Q4 2027, with the province, the capital, the realm and six heavenly levels still above you. If it clicks, wishlist it and come collect rent on launch day.

Streaming and videos are welcome, monetized or not, no need to ask. The game includes stream-friendly background music; if a YouTube upload still gets a music claim, set SETTINGS → Volume → Music to 0 (sound effects stay on).

AI was used to generate the art, part of the music and the translations, all curated and reviewed by hand. Nothing is generated at runtime.

Made by windvix, solo developer · windvix@foxmail.com

#WANGZHA #Roguelike #Deckbuilder
